description: esp32DeviceLimits (frameos/wasm/src/devices.ts, its copy frontend/src/utils/deviceLimits.ts) and esp32_device_limits (backend/app/utils/device_limits.py): the wasm renderer ceiling for an ESP32 frame. `pixelFormat` (fos_pixel_format_t, default unknown): the panel's format, which decides its canvas — one byte of luma on a grey or black-and-white panel (1, 4, 8) and RGB565 on an RGB565 LCD (9) whatever the PSRAM, RGBX while two of it fit PSRAM on any other. Replayed by cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/device-limits.test.ts and backend/app/utils/tests/test_device_limits.py.

cases.name: 7.3 inch on an 8 MB board: RGBX canvas
7.5 inch black and white on an 8 MB board: luma canvas, though RGBX fits
13.3 inch on an 8 MB board (the E1004): RGB565 canvas
10.3 inch sixteen greys on an 8 MB board (the E1003): luma canvas
the same panel size in colour: RGB565 canvas
13.3 inch on a 16 MB board: RGBX canvas
a 2 MB board: the heap floor
the SenseCAP Indicator's 480x480 RGB565 LCD: a 565 canvas that is its own frame buffer
